searchText: Do we need to return gasPrice for 1559 transactions on the JSON RPC methods ? For me it was decided to return this field for 1559 transactions in addition to maxFeePriorityPerGas and maxFeePerGas. Something changed? "gasPrice now interpreted as maxFeePerGas before the tx is mined and effectiveGasPrice after it’s mined (for EIP-1559)" `gasPrice` should be returned in addition to the 1559 fee fields - see this for more info: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/251
